question: Gastric irritation is least with following NSA1D: (PGI June 2008)
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Acetaminophen" -> "not a traditional NSAID" -> "minimal gastric irritation" -> 95%
analysis: Among the options provided, Acetaminophen (also known as Paracetamol) is known to cause less gastric irritation compared to other NSAIDs like Diclofenac, Ibuprofen, and Naproxen. This is because Acetaminophen primarily acts centrally and has minimal anti-inflammatory effects, thus sparing the gastric lining from irritation commonly seen with other NSAIDs.
